Craft AI Chat dependency license notices
Cargo.lock SHA256 (UTF-8, LF): 77db6014032f4bb7abb1f1e0d8f0692c389b5e35f2193171a0b04832ced9bdec

The shared plugin is pinned in Cargo.lock. Its own licenses and notices ship separately.
This file preserves license texts for registry packages newly introduced by the plugin.
For byteorder 1.5.0 and fiat-crypto 0.2.9, the MIT option is selected.
